title: Nothing to Worry About
question: What was the difference between Bruce's behaviour and that of other people?

meanings.usage: 常用被动语态be perturbed，描述人因外界因素感到焦虑、慌乱
后可直接接名词/动名词，反义词为overestimate
表示颠簸时常与over/along搭配，描述车辆在不平路面行驶的状态
常与to do搭配，表示转向的目的，也可与off搭配表示偏离路线
修饰动作，暗示即将发生不好的事情
常与in/through搭配，描述外力导致物体出现裂口的状态
既可以指具体的障碍物，也可以指抽象的困难、阻碍
常与of搭配，描述密集生长的植物或聚集的块状物
指岩石、地面等出现的狭长深裂缝
常用复数形式，表示多次反复的请求
描述物体或人跨越在某个事物两侧的状态

meanings.meaning: 之字形的；锯齿形的；之字形路线
meanings.usage: 描述路线、形状呈连续的Z形转折
既可以形容水、坑等深度浅，也可以形容人思想浅薄
常与at搭配，表示向某个方向快速、鲁莽地冲过去
常用来形容金属摩擦产生的难听声音，grinding halt表示戛然而止

phrases.usage: 用于否定句中，加强否定语气，表示“一点也不，丝毫没有”

examples.en: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
examples.zh: 尽管路上满是大石头，坑坑洼洼，布鲁斯却一点也不慌。

examples.en: She was not in the least surprised by the bad news.
examples.zh: 她对这个坏消息一点也不感到惊讶。

phrases.usage: 表示“被…取代；让位于”，描述一种情况被另一种情况替代

examples.en: What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared, giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps bushes.
examples.zh: 大石头突然消失了，取而代之的是一片平原，唯一的障碍是一簇簇灌木丛，这让我们松了一大口气。

examples.en: The storm gave way to bright sunshine the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，暴风雨过后阳光明媚。

phrases.usage: 表示“作为对…的回应；响应”，引出某个动作的触发原因

examples.en: In response to renewed pleadings, Bruce stopped.
examples.zh: 在我们再次恳求下，布鲁斯停了车。

examples.en: The company changed its policy in response to customer complaints.
examples.zh: 公司为了回应客户投诉，修改了政策。

phrases.usage: 原指车辆挂上低速挡，也可引申为“放慢节奏；低速运行”

examples.en: Bruce went into a low gear and drove at a terrifying speed.
examples.zh: 布鲁斯挂上低速挡，以惊人的速度行驶。

examples.en: When you climb a steep hill, you need to go into low gear.
examples.zh: 爬陡坡的时候，你需要挂低速挡。

phrases.usage: 表示“停止；停下来”，强调逐渐停止的过程，可加形容词修饰停止的状态

examples.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.
examples.zh: 布鲁斯冲着水潭开过去，可开到中间时，车嘎吱一声停住了。

examples.en: The project came to a halt due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，项目停了下来。

phrases.usage: 作时间状语，表示“迟早，总有一天”，强调某事最终必然会发生

examples.en: We felt sure that sooner or later a stone would rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine.
examples.zh: 我们确信迟早会有石头把油箱砸个洞，或者把发动机弄坏。

examples.en: If you keep lying, people will find out sooner or later.
examples.zh: 如果你一直撒谎，大家迟早会发现的。

phrases.usage: 表示“一串；一溜；痕迹”，描述人或物经过后留下的连续痕迹

examples.en: We kept looking back, wondering if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us.
examples.zh: 我们不停地往后看，想知道是不是在身后漏了一路油。

examples.en: The hurricane left a trail of destruction across the country.
examples.zh: 飓风在全国留下了满目疮痍。

phrases.usage: 表示“向…猛冲；冲向”，带有动作鲁莽、不顾后果的意味

examples.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.
examples.zh: 布鲁斯冲着水潭开过去，可开到中间时，车嘎吱一声停住了。

examples.en: The dog charged at the stranger when he walked into the yard.
examples.zh: 陌生人走进院子时，狗朝他冲了过去。

sentences.en: The rough road across the plain soon became so bad that we tried to get Bruce to drive back to the village we had come from.
sentences.zh: 穿过平原的崎岖道路很快变得非常糟糕，以至于我们试图让布鲁斯开车回到我们来时的村庄。

sentences.en: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
sentences.zh: 尽管路面上布满了巨石和坑洞，布鲁斯却丝毫没有感到不安。

sentences.en: Glancing at his map, he informed us that the next village was a mere twenty miles away.
sentences.zh: 他扫了一眼地图，告诉我们下一个村庄只有区区二十英里远。

sentences.en: It was not that Bruce always underestimated difficulties.
sentences.zh: 并不是布鲁斯总是低估困难。

sentences.en: He simply had no sense of danger at all.
sentences.zh: 他根本就没有危险意识。

sentences.en: No matter what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go.
sentences.zh: 无论条件如何，他都认为汽车应该尽可能快地行驶。

sentences.en: As we bumped over the dusty track, we swerved to avoid large boulders.
sentences.zh: 当我们在尘土飞扬的小路上颠簸时，我们猛打方向盘以避开大块巨石。

sentences.en: The wheels scooped up stones which hammered ominously under the car.
sentences.zh: 车轮卷起石子，在车底下发出不祥的敲击声。

sentences.en: We felt sure that sooner or later a stone would rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine.
sentences.zh: 我们确信迟早会有石子把我们的油箱撕开一个洞或者损坏发动机。

sentences.en: Because of this, we kept looking back, wondering if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们不停地回头看，想知道我们是否在身后留下了一串油迹和汽油。

sentences.en: What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared,
sentences.zh: 当巨石突然消失时，我们松了一口气，

sentences.en: giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是一片平坦的开阔地，那里唯一的障碍物是灌木丛。

sentences.en: But there was worse to come. Just ahead of us there was a huge fissure.
sentences.zh: 但更糟糕的还在后面。就在我们前方，有一道巨大的裂缝。

sentences.en: In response to renewed pleadings, Bruce stopped.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯响应我们再次的恳求，停了下来。

sentences.en: Though we all got out to examine the fissure, he remained in the car.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们都下车检查裂缝，他却仍然待在车里。

sentences.en: We informed him that the fissure extended for fifty yards and was two feet wide and four feet deep.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉他，那道裂缝绵延五十码，宽两英尺，深四英尺。

sentences.en: Even this had no effect.
sentences.zh: 即使这样也毫无作用。

sentences.en: Bruce went into a low gear and drove at a terrifying speed,
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯挂入低档，以惊人的速度行驶，

sentences.en: keeping the front wheels astride the crack as he followed its zigzag course.
sentences.zh: 让前轮跨过裂缝，沿着它之字形的路线前进。

sentences.en: Before we had time to worry about what might happen, we were back on the plain again.
sentences.zh: 还没等我们有时间担心会发生什么，我们又回到了平原上。

sentences.en: Bruce consulted the map once more and told us that the village was now only fifteen miles away.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯又一次查阅了地图，告诉我们村庄现在只剩下十五英里远了。

sentences.en: Our next obstacle was a shallow pool of water about half a mile across.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一个障碍是一个大约半英里宽的浅水池。

sentences.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯冲了过去，但在水池中央，汽车嘎然而止。

sentences.en: A yellow light on the dashboard flashed angrily and Bruce cheerfully announced that there was no oil in the engine!
sentences.zh: 仪表盘上一个黄灯愤怒地闪烁着，布鲁斯却高兴地宣布发动机里没油了！

exercises.prompt: “不祥地；有凶兆地” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: ominously · /ˈɒmɪnəsli/ · adverb · 不祥地；有凶兆地。修饰动作，暗示即将发生不好的事情

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：恳求；乞求
exercises.explain: pleading · /ˈpliːdɪŋ/ · noun · 恳求；乞求。常用复数形式，表示多次反复的请求

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：She was not _____ surprised by the bad news.
exercises.hint: 她对这个坏消息一点也不感到惊讶。
exercises.explain: in the least：用于否定句中，加强否定语气，表示“一点也不，丝毫没有”（她对这个坏消息一点也不感到惊讶。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：Even this had no _____
exercises.explain: Even this had no effect. — 即使这样也毫无作用。

exercises.prompt: “表示“无论什么”，引导让步状语，强调不管出现什么情况，主句的动作或状态都不会改变” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: No matter what + 从句，主句
options: no matter what引导的让步状语从句
情态动词 + have + 过去分词 (Modal + Perfect Infinitive)
定语从句 (Relative Clause) - 关系副词where引导
一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律
exercises.explain: no matter what引导的让步状语从句：No matter what + 从句，主句：no matter what相当于whatever，在从句中可作主语或宾语，同类结构还有no matter when/where/how等

source.title: no matter what引导的让步状语从句

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.
options: 他飞越海峡仅七英里，发动机就失灵了，被迫降落在海面上。
这种事情发生在小说里是完全可以的。
布鲁斯冲了过去，但在水池中央，汽车嘎然而止。
当拉姆齐夫人告诉警察她所做的一切时，警察都惊呆了。
exercises.explain: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt. — 布鲁斯冲了过去，但在水池中央，汽车嘎然而止。

source.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt.

grammar.title: even though/even if引导的让步状语从句
grammar.definition: 用来引导让步状语，表示“尽管，即使”，强调主句描述的情况不受从句情况的影响，存在转折关系
grammar.structure: Even though/Even if + 从句，主句
grammar.usage: even though多引导已经发生的事实，even if多引导假设的情况，二者在很多场景下可通用，从句可以放在主句前或主句后

examples.en: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
examples.zh: 尽管路上满是大石头，坑坑洼洼，布鲁斯却一点也不慌。

examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still hold the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，我们还是会举办运动会。

grammar.title: no matter what引导的让步状语从句
grammar.definition: 表示“无论什么”，引导让步状语，强调不管出现什么情况，主句的动作或状态都不会改变
grammar.structure: No matter what + 从句，主句
grammar.usage: no matter what相当于whatever，在从句中可作主语或宾语，同类结构还有no matter when/where/how等

examples.en: No matter what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go.
examples.zh: 不管路况如何，他都认为车应该能开多快就开多快。

examples.en: No matter what difficulties we meet, we will never give up.
examples.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，我们都不会放弃。

grammar.title: 现在分词作伴随/结果状语
grammar.definition: 现在分词（短语）可以在句中作状语，用来表示和主句动作同时发生的伴随动作，或者主句动作带来的自然结果
grammar.usage: 现在分词的逻辑主语必须和主句主语一致，表伴随时动作与主句动作同时发生，表结果时是主句动作产生的意料之中的结果

examples.en: Glancing at his map, he informed us that the next village was a mere twenty miles away.
examples.zh: 他看了一眼地图，告诉我们下一个村子只有20英里远了。

examples.en: The fire lasted nearly a month, leaving nothing valuable.
examples.zh: 大火持续了近一个月，没留下什么值钱的东西。

patterns.pattern: It was not that... It was simply that...

original.en: It was not that Bruce always underestimated difficulties. He simply had no sense of danger at all.
original.zh: 并不是布鲁斯总低估困难，他根本就完全没有危险意识。

examples.en: It was not that she doesn't like the gift. She simply thinks it's too expensive.
examples.zh: 并不是她不喜欢这个礼物，她只是觉得它太贵了。

examples.en: It was not that the task is too hard. We simply don't have enough time to finish it.
examples.zh: 并不是任务太难，我们只是没有足够的时间完成它。

patterns.pattern: What a relief it was when...

original.en: What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared, giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps bushes.
original.zh: 大石头突然消失了，取而代之的是一片平原，唯一的障碍是一簇簇灌木丛，这让我们松了一大口气。

examples.en: What a relief it was when the final exam ended and we could go on vacation.
examples.zh: 期末考试结束了，我们可以去度假了，真是太让人松口气了。

examples.en: What a relief it was when the missing child was found safe and sound.
examples.zh: 失踪的孩子被安然无恙地找到了，真是让人松了一大口气。

original.en: The rough road across the plain soon became so bad that we tried to get Bruce to drive back to the village we had come from.
original.zh: 穿越平原的崎岖道路很快变得极差，我们都试图让布鲁斯开回我们来的那个村子。

examples.en: The movie was so touching that almost everyone in the cinema cried.
examples.zh: 这部电影太感人了，电影院里几乎所有人都哭了。

examples.en: He spoke so fast that I could hardly catch what he was saying.
examples.zh: 他说得太快了，我几乎跟不上他说的内容。
